title: Enablement Sprint: Concise QuickCards, Objection Matrix, and Live Demo Kits
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, field-ready enablement bundle for the runtime-1.20 release focused on fast ramp for Sales and Customer Success. Bundle should be consumable in a 15-minute read or a 30-minute live session and minimize follow-up questions. Deliverables: 1) One-page QuickCards (feature summary, positioning, target customer, key metrics), 2) Objection Handling Matrix (top 8 objections + one-liner responses and escalation play), 3) Three scripted Live Demo Kits (starter script, expected output examples, failover demo steps), 4) Release Notes QuickSync (two-slide summary for SDRs), and 5) a 45-minute enablement recording for on-demand use.
tasks: Draft QuickCard templates and get PM + Design signoff (owner: PM)
Pull telemetry + perf numbers for runtime-1.20 to populate metrics (owner: Eng)
Create Objection Matrix draft and circulate to Sales leads for feedback (owner: CS)
Record three demo runs and extract 5-minute clips for each scenario (owner: DevRel)
Prepare two-slide Release Notes QuickSync and post to release channel (owner: PM)
Schedule 45-minute live enablement session and capture attendance (owner: SalesOps)
Publish final assets to Drive + Confluence and update sales enablement tracker (owner: PM)
Collect and incorporate feedback from first enablement session into v1.1 (owner: PM)
Link demo recordings to GitHub example repo and add README snippets (owner: Eng)
Create a short quiz (5 questions) for CS certification and ship with assets (owner: CS)
acceptance_criteria: QuickCards: three one-page PDFs covering Use Case, Value props, Key metrics; design approved by Design; copy approved by PM
Objection Matrix: covers top 8 objections from discovery calls, includes one-line response + escalation path, Sales leadership signoff
Demo Kits: three reproducible demo scripts with seed prompts, expected outputs, and rollback steps; demo recordings uploaded and timestamped
Release Notes QuickSync: two-slide summary shared in #release-announce Slack and pinned in Confluence
Training: 45-minute recorded session published and at least 50% of target field team viewed or attended within two weeks
